threads.body: This example now requires boto3>=1.43.89, but the Bedrock instrumentation package itself still advertises support for `boto3 >= 1.40.46, < 2` (declared in its `pyproject.toml`/`package.py` and asserted in tests). Please either update the package’s declared minimum (and related references) or keep the example requirement aligned with the package’s supported minimum.

This bumps the example’s boto3 lower bound to 1.43.89, but the actual package dependency still declares `boto3 >= 1.40.46, < 2` (e.g., bedrock `pyproject.toml` optional-deps, `package.py`, and `tests/test_instrumentor.py`). Either raise the package’s declared minimum to match (and update the related README/lockfile/test expectations), or keep this example aligned with the package’s supported range.

The PR title indicates the boto3 dependency minimum is being raised, but this change only updates the docs build requirements; the Bedrock package’s declared supported range remains `boto3 >= 1.40.46, < 2` (and is referenced in tests and the root README table). Please either update the package’s dependency metadata/tests/docs to consistently reflect the new minimum, or adjust the PR scope/title to clarify this is docs-only.
